Name: ClavicleAdvance
Description: This will create a Clavicle Advance system

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create a Clavicle Advance system.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only).
- TwistAmount: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- Ribbon: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- SetGameParent: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Template parent examples: L_Clavicle_Jnt, L_Clavicle_Ctrl, StellarClavicle.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
